job.title: Production Technician
job.description:
Production Technician

Are you a meticulous and hands-on problem solver with a passion for precision craftsmanship? We’re seeking a dedicated Production Technician to join a dynamic team responsible for high-quality electromechanical assembly and testing in a fast-paced manufacturing environment. This essential role ensures that production processes run smoothly from start to finish, supporting scale-up efforts critical to global distribution centers. If you thrive in a collaborative setting, prioritize safety, and excel at troubleshooting, this opportunity is your next career step.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead assigned production tasks from inception to completion, including mechanical, electrical, and electro-mechanical assembly.
  • Execute builds following detailed work instructions and manufacturing protocols.
  • Conduct thorough testing to ensure product quality and functionality.
  • Document progress accurately, identify blockers, and escalate issues promptly.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve production challenges efficiently.
  • Maintain compliance with safety standards and operational procedures.
  • Offer feedback to improve documentation and manufacturing processes for ongoing efficiency.

Required Skills:

  • Strong mechanical, electrical, or electro-mechanical assembly experience.
  • Hands-on proficiency with tools and test equipment relevant to electromechanical systems.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and craftsmanship.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve problems quickly and effectively.
  • Excellent documentation skills and commitment to process accuracy.
  • Strong communication skills and team collaboration mindset.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Prior experience in high-volume manufacturing environments.
  • Familiarity with lean manufacturing principles or continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Experience working with manufacturing work instructions and documentation tools.
  • Exposure to safety protocols related to electromechanical operations.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Technical school diploma, associate’s degree, or equivalent technical training preferred.
  • 2+ years of hands-on assembly and testing experience, ideally in a production setting.

Other Requirements:

  • This role is onsite in South San Francisco and requires physical presence — remote work is not available.
  • Ability to work on a 6-month assignment with potential for extension.
  • Must adhere to all safety and operational protocols.

Join a team committed to delivering reliable, scalable solutions that power distribution centers worldwide. Bring your craftsmanship and problem-solving skills to this vital production role and make an impact behind the scenes of global logistics.

job.title: Incoming Quality Control Technician
job.description:
Incoming Quality Control Technician

Join a pioneering team dedicated to advancing autonomous delivery systems as an Incoming Quality Control Technician. In this critical role, you'll ensure that every component meets the highest standards of safety, performance, and reliability, directly contributing to innovative solutions that are shaping the future of logistics. This onsite opportunity in South San Francisco offers a chance to develop and refine essential quality assurance processes in a dynamic, high-tech environment.

What You’ll Do:

  • Operate structural-test equipment on incoming materials, executing load-and-stress protocols to verify integrity.
  • Conduct comprehensive part inspections—dimensional, visual, and functional—using a variety of precision tools.
  • Perform detailed assessments of carbon fiber components, detecting delaminations, voids, or deviations, and identify discrepancies.
  • Read, interpret, and apply engineering drawings, blueprints, and GD&T callouts to guide inspection activities.
  • Establish inspection parameters, selecting appropriate measurement tools to optimize quality checks.
  • Document inspection results accurately in our quality-management system, ensuring traceability for all parts.
  • Identify nonconformances, assign hold tags, and collaborate with engineers and suppliers on root cause analysis and corrective measures.
  • Contribute to continuous process improvements by refining inspection protocols, reducing cycle times, and standardizing best practices.

Required Skills:

  • Proven experience using hand tools such as calipers and micrometers for precise measurement.
  • Strong visual, dimensional, and functional inspection skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and GD&T callouts.
  • Experience working in regulated manufacturing environments like aerospace, medical devices, or automotive industries.
  • Comfortable documenting inspection data accurately within quality management systems.
  • Bonus: Hands-on experience inspecting composite materials, especially carbon fiber components.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Knowledge of composite material inspection techniques.
  • Additional certifications related to quality assurance or inspection.

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical training or certifications in quality inspection preferred.
  • Prior background in quality control within high-precision/high-reliability sectors is strongly desirable.
  • Experience with structural load testing and equipment operation is advantageous.

Other Requirements:

  • Onsite presence in South San Francisco is required; this role does not support remote work.
  • Immediate availability to start is preferred.
  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally and maintain strict attention to detail throughout inspection and documentation processes.

Senior Payroll Analyst

Join a dynamic, globally-minded team as a Senior Payroll Analyst and be at the forefront of ensuring seamless payroll operations across multiple international markets. This pivotal role offers an exciting opportunity to work remotely within Pacific or Mountain time zones, supporting a fast-growing company during a critical period of equity activity and expansion. What You’ll Do:

  • Process semi-monthly and monthly payroll cycles across the U.S., UK, Canada, France, and Brazil via external and local payroll providers, ensuring flawless execution and compliance.
  • Manage equity payroll activities, including RSU vesting and stock option exercises, particularly with increased volume following the company’s recent public offering.
  • Collaborate with People, Finance, and external vendors to validate employee data, reconcile reports, and resolve discrepancies.
  • Support month-end close, payroll account reconciliations, and internal/external audits.
  • Monitor global payroll legislation changes and implement updates to processes and systems.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, confidentiality, and data integrity.

Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with payroll reporting tools and HRIS platforms beyond UKG.
  • Familiarity with UK pensions and international payroll nuances.
  • Knowledgeable in payroll system optimization and process improvement.
  • Previous experience working with multi-country payroll vendors and external providers.

Preferred Education & Experience:
